# ChoreMatrix

> Deterministic Household Workload Optimizer

ChoreMatrix (https://chorematrix.online) is a web application that calculates fair, balanced household chore schedules. Rather than acting as a static checklist or random assignment generator, ChoreMatrix uses a deterministic optimization engine to allocate chores based on individual member capacity, schedule availability, task duration, effort weighting, and hard constraints.

## Core Features & Capabilities
- **Capacity-Aware Balancing:** Distributes chore minutes proportionally according to each household member's available weekly capacity.
- **Equal Workload Balancing:** Flattens chore minutes equally across all members.
- **Availability & Blackout Schedules:** Respects member-specific unavailable days to prevent impossible scheduling.
- **Effort-Weighted Tasks:** Scales task impact using duration and physical/mental effort levels (1–5).
- **Quantified Fairness Score:** Provides a transparent 0–100 balance metric derived from utilization spread across members.
- **Multi-Week Rotations:** Rotates recurring tasks across up to 4 weeks (Pro and Plus plans) to ensure long-term balance.
- **Privacy-First In-Browser Planning:** Allows anonymous visitors to customize households and calculate full 1-week plans locally without creating an account.
